info.title: Jigworks Hub API
info.description: Jigworks hub. Every endpoint except `GET /api/health` and `POST /api/session` requires the session cookie `jigworks_session` (set by `POST /api/session`) or the `X-Jigworks-Key` header carrying the hub password (HUB_PASSWORD). Engineers never log in: the runner reports `git config user.email` as author/approver. Costs are API equivalent.

AgentOutputPayload.title: AgentOutputPayload
AgentOutputPayload.description: Pass-through of stream-json content for the optional live agent output (design.md §7). One event per content block. thinking blocks are normally skipped.

AuditRecord.title: AuditRecord
AuditRecord.description: Audit trail of one run (design.md §8 Audit): who started it, release + digest, models, steps with git snapshots, gate results, who approved and when, tokens. Written by the runner to its local audit log; the hub can rebuild it from the events.

ChannelUpdate.title: ChannelUpdate
ChannelUpdate.description: Point a channel to a release (publish or rollback).

EventBatch.title: EventBatch
EventBatch.description: Ingest batch. Every event must carry runId equal to the path id and a seq; the hub stores each (runId, seq) once and counts re-sent ones as duplicates (offline queue replay is safe).

EventPage.title: EventPage
EventPage.description: Polling fallback for the SSE stream: events with seq > after.

GraphJSON.title: GraphJSON
GraphJSON.description: Normalized LangGraph get_graph() output, read-only; produced by `jigworks graph` (runner) and by the hub's Sandbox validation. Rendered with React Flow.

HumanDelta.title: HumanDelta
HumanDelta.description: PLANNED, not built (design.md §8 Human delta). What the human changed after the first result of a session. The hub shows sample data (sample=true) in the Planned outcomes panel.

InterruptPayload.title: InterruptPayload
InterruptPayload.description: LangGraph interrupt waiting for the human (design.md §7).

ModelAssignment.title: ModelAssignment
ModelAssignment.description: Models are set by the workflow release (`[models]` in workflow.toml), never picked in VS Code.

OutcomeReport.title: OutcomeReport
OutcomeReport.description: PLANNED human-delta outcomes. The hub returns sample data (sample=true) and the UI labels the panel Planned.

Permissions.title: Permissions
Permissions.description: Proposal (design.md §11.2): agent permissions declared per release.

PriceEntry.title: PriceEntry
PriceEntry.description: Price list with validity (design.md §8). Cost = Σ tokens × price of the entry valid at the call time.

RunCreate.title: RunCreate
RunCreate.description: Register a run and its pinned release. Idempotent on runId.

RunEvent.title: RunEvent
RunEvent.description: One event of a run (design.md §8). `kind` defaults to node_status, so the design example validates as-is. The payload object matching `kind` is required (see allOf). The runner sends seq (monotonic per run, from 0) on every event; the hub deduplicates on (runId, seq).

RunSummary.title: RunSummary
RunSummary.description: Current state of a run. Sent by the runner in run_finished; returned by the hub (which adds costUsd, computed from the price table at read time).

Snapshot.title: Snapshot
Snapshot.description: Git snapshot taken after a node (design.md §9: a git commit per node).

UsageLimitPayload.title: UsageLimitPayload
UsageLimitPayload.description: From the stream-json `rate_limit_event` (docs/spikes/claude-stream-json.md §5). Emitted when status is not `allowed`.

UsageRecord.title: UsageRecord
UsageRecord.description: Raw tokens of one agent call for one model (design.md §8). Claude adapter: one record per key of result.modelUsage of the final stream-json `result` event (docs/spikes/claude-stream-json.md §8). Cost is computed at read time from PriceEntry; cliCostUsd is a cross-check only.

UsageReport.title: UsageReport
UsageReport.description: Cost is labelled API equivalent: on a subscription nobody pays per token (design.md §8).

ValidationResult.title: ValidationResult
ValidationResult.description: Result of validating the draft in isolation (Vercel Sandbox). graph is present when compile succeeded; the editor's Graph toggle renders it.

WorkflowManifest.title: WorkflowManifest
WorkflowManifest.description: workflow.toml of a workflow package, parsed (design.md §5).
